value.title: Rear hub clicking under load
value.description: Alex Demo reports that the rear hub on the Contoso Trail 500 started clicking after about two hundred kilometres. The noise is worse under load on climbs and disappears when coasting. The bike was bought in June, the hub was serviced once by a local shop, and the customer wants to know whether the warranty still applies and who should inspect it.

value.title: Question about delivery window
value.description: Alex Demo asks when the replacement saddle will be delivered to the Lisbon store and whether the delivery can be moved to the following week because the shop is closed for stocktaking on the original date and nobody can sign for the parcel.

value.title: Warranty claim for cracked frame
value.description: A customer reports a hairline crack near the bottom bracket of a frame that is fourteen months old, with photos attached to the email, and asks for a replacement frame or a refund under the extended frame warranty. The bike was used for commuting only and has never been in an accident, according to the customer.

value.title: Display error E21 on the Contoso Volt
value.description: The Contoso Volt display shows error E21 after a firmware update to version 3.2. The customer already restarted the bike and re-seated the battery, and the error returns within a minute. Please advise whether a rollback to the previous firmware is possible without visiting a service point.
